title: Register R User-Defined Functions in DuckDB
text: Rducks registers R functions DuckDB SQL functions using package-managed DuckDB C extension. extension records DuckDB database instance load time keeps extension-owned connections native registration callbacks. built around explicit type descriptors, direct DuckDB-vector marshalling, strict rule R object work runs recorded R thread. Rducks organized around DuckDB function kind, scalar-UDF evaluation mode, execution plan. Scalar UDFs registered rducks_register_scalar_udf() choose mode = "scalar" one R call per row mode = "vectorized" one R call per DuckDB chunk. Two execution transports available: -process (transport = "inproc") worker-process (transport = "ipc", native NNG request/reply, default local workers launched mirai, optional mori sharing selected globals). Aggregates use rducks_register_aggregate().

code: plan <- rducks_execution_plan("ipc", ipc_workers = 2L) rducks_set_execution_plan(con, plan, threads = 1L, external_threads = 1L) rducks_register_scalar_udf(con, "r_par", function(x) x + 1L, args = INTEGER, returns = INTEGER) rducks_set_execution_plan(con, plan, threads = 3L, external_threads = 2L) dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT sum(r_par((i % 1000)::INTEGER)) AS total FROM range(20000) t(i)") plan <- rducks_execution_plan("inproc") plan #> <rducks_execution_plan> #>   plan_id:     direct+inproc_concurrent #>   engine_id:   direct_main_queue #>   transport:   inproc #>   concurrency: inproc_concurrent #>   reference:   no #>   implemented: yes #>   call shapes: scalar, vectorized  # Register single-threaded, then raise DuckDB threads for concurrent execution # of the already-registered UDF; off-main worker callbacks queue to the # recorded R thread. rducks_register_scalar_udf(   con,   name = "r_inc",   fun = function(x) x + 1L,   args = INTEGER,   returns = INTEGER,   mode = "vectorized" ) #> <rducks_scalar_udf_registration> #>   registered:      yes #>   name:            r_inc #>   evaluation_mode: vectorized #>   plan:            direct+serial #>   signature:       r_inc(INTEGER) -> INTEGER rducks_set_execution_plan(con, plan, threads = 4L, external_threads = 1L) dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT sum(r_inc((i % 1000)::INTEGER)) AS total FROM range(20000) t(i)") #>      total #> 1 10010000 rducks_set_execution_plan(con, plan, threads = 1L, external_threads = 1L)

title: Register R User-Defined Functions in DuckDB
text: inproc runs every R callback single recorded R thread, expensive per-chunk UDF serializes even DuckDB scans parallel. transport = "ipc" fans chunks worker R processes, per-chunk cost overlaps worth marshalling. benchmark registers sleeping vectorized UDF three plans runs one large parallel CSV scan. UDF closes random R lookup vector; third plan ships global workers mori shared memory (ipc_globals_share = "mori"). Timings illustrative machine-dependent.
code: set.seed(1) lookup <- sample.int(20L, 1000L, replace = TRUE) slow_lookup <- function(x) {   Sys.sleep(0.05)   x + lookup[[1L]] }  duckdb_vector_size <- 2048L csv_rows <- duckdb_vector_size * 64L csv_pad <- strrep("x", 128L) csv_path <- tempfile("rducks-readme-csv-", fileext = ".csv") writeLines(   c("i,pad", paste0(seq.int(0L, csv_rows - 1L), ",", csv_pad)),   csv_path )  ipc_workers <- 2L plans <- list(   inproc = rducks_execution_plan("inproc"),   ipc = rducks_execution_plan(     "ipc",     ipc_workers = ipc_workers,     ipc_timeout = 60,     ipc_globals = "lookup"   ),   ipc_mori = rducks_execution_plan(     "ipc",     ipc_workers = ipc_workers,     ipc_timeout = 60,     ipc_globals = "lookup",     ipc_globals_share = "mori"   ) ) udfs <- paste0("r_bench_", names(plans))  # Register each UDF single-threaded under its plan; for the ipc plans this # starts the worker processes and broadcasts the UDF (and its globals). for (i in seq_along(plans)) {   rducks_set_execution_plan(con, plans[[i]], threads = 1L, external_threads = 1L)   rducks_register_scalar_udf(     con,     name = udfs[[i]],     fun = slow_lookup,     args = INTEGER,     returns = INTEGER,     mode = "vectorized",     side_effects = TRUE   ) }  run_plan <- function(label, udf, plan, threads, external_threads) {   rducks_set_execution_plan(con, plan, threads = threads, external_threads = external_threads)   elapsed <- system.time({     result <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, sprintf(       paste(         "SELECT sum(%s((i %% 1000)::INTEGER)) AS total",         "FROM read_csv(%s, header = true,",         "columns = {'i': 'INTEGER', 'pad': 'VARCHAR'}, parallel = true)"       ),       DBI::dbQuoteIdentifier(con, udf),       DBI::dbQuoteString(con, csv_path)     ))   })[["elapsed"]]   data.frame(label = label, total = result$total[[1]], elapsed_sec = round(elapsed, 3)) }  benchmark <- rbind(   run_plan("inproc (single R thread)", udfs[[1]], plans[[1]],            threads = 1L, external_threads = 1L),   run_plan("ipc (2 workers)", udfs[[2]], plans[[2]],            threads = ipc_workers + 1L, external_threads = ipc_workers),   run_plan("ipc + mori (2 workers)", udfs[[3]], plans[[3]],            threads = ipc_workers + 1L, external_threads = ipc_workers) ) unlink(csv_path, force = TRUE) rducks_set_execution_plan(con, rducks_execution_plan("inproc"),                           threads = 1L, external_threads = 1L) benchmark #>                      label    total elapsed_sec #> 1 inproc (single R thread) 65961344       3.342 #> 2          ipc (2 workers) 65961344       1.936 #> 3   ipc + mori (2 workers) 65961344       1.923

Automatic capture estimates serialized globals payload warns exceeds option rducks.ipc_globals.warn_bytes (8 MiB default); option rducks.ipc_globals.max_bytes can set hard byte limit. Set ipc_globals_share = "mori" pass selected globals mori shared memory references -host workers; Rducks keeps shared objects anchored registered scalar UDF lifetime. Use ipc_packages packages workers attach, ipc_globals = FALSE rely serialized UDF closure explicit task state, character vector / named list explicit extra globals. ipc_timeout positive finite provider wait timeout seconds; NULL uses finite default 30 seconds. ipc_endpoints optionally supplies NNG endpoint URLs worker processes caller starts stops; processes must run Rducks NNG worker loop. NNG URL transport supported endpoints allowed. endpoints supplied, ipc_transport selects transport used mirai-launched local worker endpoints must left NULL explicit ipc_endpoints supplied. Rducks retries local TCP/WebSocket startup fresh endpoint bundles startup-ping failure; caller-supplied endpoints remain caller-owned fail fast. "abstract" means Linux abstract IPC, "ipc" means NNG IPC (Unix-domain sockets POSIX named pipes Windows), "unix" means POSIX Unix-domain alias, "tcp" / "ws" use loopback TCP / WebSocket endpoints. default "abstract" Linux "ipc" elsewhere. ipc_globals_share selected IPC globals represented worker broadcast. "none" serializes registration payload. "mori" applies mori::share() selected global serialization, can turn large atomic vectors, lists, data frames -host shared-memory references. requires optional mori package workers machine. ipc_provider Worker provider transport = "ipc". "nng" supported. NNG provider broadcasts registered scalar UDF closure plus discovered globals/packages every worker shared database-runtime provider pool, avoid capturing large objects UDF environments unless memory cost intended ipc_globals_share = "mori" appropriate. ipc_workers Number persistent NNG workers. ipc_max_pending Maximum simultaneous native NNG requests admitted per registered scalar-UDF client pool.
